instructions: The macOS version of Catchlight, a zero-knowledge notes app that holds the owner's real daily notes. It must read and write the same encrypted Takes and sync format as the iOS app (Considus/Catchlight-iOS), so treat any divergence from that shared crypto contract or file format as a breaking bug. Reviews cost a credit from a 30-a-month budget, so spend the comments on correctness, security and broken contracts rather than taste. Weight the review towards anything that can lose or expose a note: key derivation and the Keychain, sync round-trips where every field must survive, and destructive paths. AGENTS.md is the source of truth for the ground rules.
